design_overview: A clean, modern task management application designed for simplicity and efficiency. The interface prioritizes quick task creation, easy status toggling, and clear visual separation between active and completed tasks. The design follows iOS/Android native patterns with bottom navigation, card-based layouts, and touch-optimized interactions. Visual hierarchy emphasizes primary actions (creating and completing tasks) while keeping secondary actions (deletion, filtering) accessible but subtle.

screens.name: Create Task
screens.purpose: Screen for creating a new task with title and optional description

key_components.interaction: Tap back arrow to return to Task List

key_components.name: Title Input
key_components.styling: White background, rounded border (8px), 16px padding, placeholder 'Task title *' in gray, 16px font size, required field indicator
key_components.interaction: Tap to focus and enter task title, shows error border if submitted empty

key_components.name: Description Input
key_components.styling: White background, rounded border (8px), 16px padding, multiline text area, placeholder 'Add description (optional)' in gray, 120px min-height
key_components.interaction: Tap to focus and enter task description, optional field

key_components.name: Character Count
key_components.styling: Gray text, 12px, right-aligned below description input, shows '0/500 characters'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, updates as user types

key_components.name: Error Message
key_components.styling: Red text (#EF4444), 14px, appears below title input when validation fails, 'Title is required'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, appears on validation error

key_components.name: Create Button
key_components.styling: Primary color background (#4F46E5), white text, 'Create Task' label, full width with 16px margin, 48px height, rounded 8px, bold text
key_components.interaction: Tap to validate and create task, navigates back to Task List on success, shows error if title empty

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.styling: White background, gray border, gray text, 'Cancel' label, full width with 16px margin, 48px height, rounded 8px, positioned above Create button
key_components.interaction: Tap to discard changes and return to Task List

key_components.name: Keyboard Spacer
key_components.styling: Transparent, adjusts height when keyboard appears to keep buttons visible
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, responsive to keyboard state

screens.user_flow: From Task List tap plus button → Enter task title (required) → Optionally add description → Tap Create to save → Return to Task List with new task visible → Or tap Cancel to discard

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices. Layouts use flexible containers with percentage-based widths and max-width constraints. Touch targets minimum 44x44px for accessibility. Bottom navigation fixed at viewport bottom. Floating action button repositions on keyboard appearance. Cards stack vertically on mobile, maintain consistent 16px margins. Typography scales proportionally. Modals adapt to screen height with scrollable content if needed.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for text. Touch targets minimum 44x44px. Screen reader labels on all interactive elements. Semantic HTML structure. Focus indicators visible on all focusable elements. Error messages announced to screen readers. Color not sole indicator of state (icons and text reinforce). Keyboard navigation support for web version. Dynamic font sizing support.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability without distraction. Button press: 100ms scale (0.98) and opacity (0.8). Card tap: 150ms elevation increase. Checkbox toggle: 200ms checkmark draw animation. Screen transitions: 300ms slide with ease-out curve. Modal appearance: 250ms fade-in with slight scale. FAB press: ripple effect 300ms. List item press: 100ms background color change. All animations respect reduced motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon set using outline style for visual clarity. Icons sized 24px for standard use, 20px for compact areas, 48px for emphasis. Primary icons: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person outline), settings (gear), bell (notification), bookmark (ribbon), heart (favorite), filter (funnel), plus (add), edit (pencil), trash (bin), share (arrow). Icons use currentColor for easy theming. No emojis used to maintain professional appearance.
